# PR #1611: Patch: the duos fuzz varies team rules, handicaps and dealt decks

Closes #1573

The duos fuzz gate now plays each seed under a co-op match's setup instead of the same default options on every seed.

What changed: [crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-1573/crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs) gains `DUOS_FUZZ_TIERS`, `DUOS_DEALT_SEATS`, `DuosSetup` (tier plus dealt seats), `duos_setup_for_seed` (tier by seed modulo 3, dealt seats by the quotient, so every 12 consecutive seeds cover all 12 pairings), `duos_decks_for_handicaps` (one seeded shuffle of `FUZZ_POOL` dealt in seat order at each seat's deck size, R184), and `duos_options_for_seed` (team A `DUOS_HUMAN_TEAM` with no handicap; team B `duos_ai_team(tier)` with `AI_DIFFICULTY[tier]` on B1/B2, none at Easy). `play_duos_game_inner` creates every game from it. Failure reports now print the setup label, the fold-relevant options as JSON, and all four decks, and `--duos --json` carries each failure's whole `DuosCreateOptions`. `duos_decks_for_seed` is kept `#[cfg(test)]` for the co-op games `replay.rs` tests deal. [crates/tools/README.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-1573/crates/tools/README.md) documents the rotation in the `fuzz` row. No engine, spec, or other files touched; no ruling added (R184, R433 and §13.7 already settle the rules).

How tested: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh duos_fuzz` — 19 passed, 0 failed (14 existing unchanged, including smoke seeds 1–3, seed 1427, and the planted sick-attack/growth/probe/checkpoint tests, plus the 5 new ones pinning the rotation, two-seeds-differ, co-op-match setup at tiers 1–3, the `create_duel` dealt filter on both duels, and the failure report text plus JSON). `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh replay` — 16 passed. `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `spec check` (1077 rulings ok), `catalog check`, `patches check` all pass; `classify --base origin/main --claims` reports Internal. Release `fuzz --duos --seeds 200`: 0 failed; endings poolEmptied 199, duelResult 1; wall time 2:02.75 against the 58.7 s baseline — about 2.1x, more than double, as the plan said to flag.

Decisions: followed the plan exactly with no departures. Team B is always the AI team and team A always unhandicapped, mirroring `dealt_options` (rejected rotating the AI side, which no match does). The `[A2, B1]` dealt rotation deals a team B seat, which production never does, kept so the filter's `p2` mapping is covered (the random policy reads no library). Easy seeds pass `teams`/`handicaps` as `Some`, as the server does, rather than `None`. No per-setup summary counts, as beyond the acceptance criteria.

Reviewer look-twice: the deck deal order (A1, A2 first at `DECK_SIZE`, so team A decks are byte-identical to pre-change seeds) is what keeps the planted A1-side tests' step conditions valid under the rotation; smoke seed 3 now plays a dealt game through, which the green suite confirms.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.
